decision: Renew Implant Centre is already the master hub on https://www.renewimplants.ca. Educational posts stay on /blog/. Do not launch a second domain, a /learn/ duplicate of /blog/, or city price pages.

blogs.reason: Copying the same article onto another domain splits authority and creates duplicates. The Gemini canonical-tag rotation is not the path for this brand.

social.rule: The same Renew-branded asset may be posted to another account only after a person changes the last line to that clinic and confirms the account. The layout stays on this design system.
